title: Kierland 6BR | Pool, Spa & Putting Green
description: Welcome to Desert Diamond Getaway, a spacious six-bedroom Scottsdale retreat just minutes from Kierland Commons, Scottsdale Quarter and TPC Scottsdale. Designed for families traveling together, the home features two private king suites, two living areas, a fully equipped kitchen and sleeping space for up to 18 guests. Outside, enjoy a private pool, hot tub, putting green, grill and covered patio.
